description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmploymentContractAPI in the OrangeHRM PIM module. It tests various API methods, including retrieving, updating, creating, and deleting employment contracts and associated attachments, using mock objects and predefined data.

classes.name: EmploymentContractAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmploymentContractAPI endpoints, including CRUD operations for employment contracts and handling contract attachments.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating specific database tables before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentContractService
methods.description: Verifies that the API correctly returns an instance of EmploymentContractService.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures calling delete() results in a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures getValidationRuleForDelete() throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single employment contract by employee number, including cases where the contract exists or does not.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the rules for the 'getOne' API endpoint for a valid employee number.

methods.name: testUpdateOnlyDates
methods.description: Tests updating only the start and/or end dates of an employment contract.

methods.name: updateOnlyDatesDataProvider
methods.description: Provides data for the testUpdateOnlyDates method with various combinations of dates.

methods.name: testUpdateNewContractAttachment
methods.description: Tests creating a new contract attachment during an employment contract update.

methods.name: testUpdateNewContractAttachmentBadRequest
methods.description: Tests handling of bad request when trying to keep current contract attachment with invalid input.

methods.name: testUpdateDeleteContractAttachment
methods.description: Tests deleting the current contract attachment.

methods.name: testUpdateReplaceContractAttachment
methods.description: Tests replacing the existing contract attachment with a new one.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for updating employment contracts.

methods.name: setDateTimeHelper
methods.description: Sets up a mock DateTimeHelperService to return a fixed current date for tests.
